title: Metrics schema + Analytics collector skeleton
description: Define MetricsSnapshot Pydantic schema matching SPEC 6.1 metrics_timeseries columns. Create AnalyticsCollector agent skeleton that polls metrics at configurable intervals (1h/6h/24h/7d/30d) and writes MetricsSnapshot records. Support dry-run mode for development without live API credentials.
sub_tasks: Define MetricsSnapshot schema (views, likes, shares, saves, comments, avg_watch_pct, ctr, conversions, gmv_thb)
Create AnalyticsCollector class with collect(publish_record_id, schedule) method
Wire dry-run transport that returns fixture metrics
Unit tests for schema validation + collector lifecycle
